title: Keyboard ke F aur J keys par bumps kyun hote hain? ⌨️

shots.vo: अपना कीबोर्ड देखिए। दो keys पर छोटे-छोटे उभार होते हैं। F और J।
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a laptop keyboard showing a small raised bump on a key, shallow depth of field, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Apna keyboard dekhiye. Do keys par chhote-chhote ubhaar hote hain. F aur J.

shots.vo: बाकी हर key चिकनी है। तो सिर्फ़ यही दो क्यों?
shots.prompt: a person's fingertip gently touching a key on a dark keyboard, macro, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Baaki har key chikni hai. Toh sirf yahi do kyun?

shots.vo: क्योंकि यहीं आपकी index fingers रखी जानी चाहिए।
shots.prompt: two hands resting on a keyboard in typing position, top-down, soft light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Kyunki yahin aapki index fingers rakhi jaani chahiye.

shots.vo: तेज़ टाइप करने वाले keys को देखते नहीं। वो इन उभारों को महसूस करते हैं।
shots.prompt: a person typing quickly while looking at the screen, keyboard in the foreground, motion blur, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Tez type karne wale keys ko dekhte nahi. Wo in ubhaaron ko mehsoos karte hain.

shots.vo: index fingers को ये मिल जाएँ, तो बाकी उँगलियाँ अपनी जगह पर आ जाती हैं। इस row को home row कहते हैं।
shots.prompt: close-up of eight fingers resting on keyboard keys, glowing light on the middle row, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Index fingers ko ye mil jaayein, toh baaki ungliyaan apni jagah par aa jaati hain. Is row ko home row kehte hain.

shots.vo: हाथ उठाइए, बिना देखे वापस रखिए, और आप ठीक वहीं होंगे जहाँ शुरू किया था।
shots.prompt: hands hovering above a keyboard in darkness, then landing on the keys, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Haath uthaiye, bina dekhe wapas rakhiye, aur aap theek wahin honge jahan shuru kiya tha.

shots.vo: यही trick आपको number पाँच पर, number pad और phone keypad पर भी मिलेगी।
shots.prompt: a calculator style number pad with a tiny raised bump on the centre key, macro, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Yahi trick aapko number paanch par, number pad aur phone keypad par bhi milegi.

shots.vo: दो छोटे उभार। बिना देखे टाइप किए गए लाखों शब्द।
shots.prompt: a glowing keyboard in a dark room at night, cozy atmosphere, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name
shots.caption: Do chhote ubhaar. Bina dekhe type kiye gaye laakhon shabd.

voice.description: Divya speaks in a calm, expressive storytelling voice at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-sounding, with no background noise.
